steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: What's going on? Is it thundering?

steps.name: Street Passerby
steps.text: It looks like it's storming in the mountains. What's been happening with the weather recently...

steps.name: Street Passerby
steps.text: Hm? Is there something above there...?

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Huh? Can anyone tell what that is?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: We've been stuck in here for two or three days now.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: If we still can't find a way out, maybe that means...

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Quiet.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Hahah... perhaps someday a good mood will strike Dusk on the outside, and she'll let us all out.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: That said, where might that pole-carrier sir be?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: His son's buried in the mountains. He doesn't want to run in with us in a place like this.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I've heard tell of the grievances between you two... but, erm... must you settle matters by such means?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: What else?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I just feel that...

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Don't bother feeling about it.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Bystanders always think they understand it all, but people's empathy always turns out to have limits.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I know in my heart what the right thing to do is, what's 'necessary' and what's 'unnecessary.' It's common sense. Anyone would know.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: But sometimes, our feelings won't listen to sense.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: It's raining?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: *Sigh* Well, it's not as if just waiting around like this poses much problem.

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkh...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Why don't you all give raising an Ink Spirit a try? I've discovered that if you just grant these things a level mind and calm approach, they're actually quite affectionate...

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkh...?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: This goes to show the Sui Regulator had reason to beware her.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Alright, alright, there's not much to gain from quarrelling over them in here... how about we head inside, away from the rain?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Strange how it can rain in here, too.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Truly strange how what falls isn't even ink.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Mr. Taihe? Won't you come in?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: What of Master Shen?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: What's the Master up to? It's been a moment now, but he's still fixated on his palms...

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Are you watching the rain?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: According to Nothing, this whole world is just her scroll. Artwork all around, vivid and lifelike.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: At sunrise, fowls fly from the steep forests, mist covers the land. You see sunlight without the sun itself, reflections of thousands of floors, and all is silent.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: If this is a painting, then who knows just what this artist has seen within Yan's scenery...

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: How refined, Rainmaster.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: I only know that Rainmaster of Duckweeds Shen Lou once served ten years in the army. Who knew he was so versed in literature?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: ...*Sigh*. I've just been around for a while.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: The only shame is that rain in spring shouldn't be so warm.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Go. Part this open.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Wh-Where are we?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Very wise, Rainmaster.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I did it without thinking.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Shang Zhong.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Was this the reason you all fought over the goblet?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: The clouds roll above the mountains. What's happening over there?

steps.name: 'Sui-Xiang'
steps.text: (Wordless roar)

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Ugh, I'm getting a little twitchy now.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Oh... more resilient than the Sui-Xiang I met alone, it seems.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Mere lofty posture. It possesses Its form, but ultimately, has not Its spirit.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: We're still here. What 'spirit' is it going to have?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: It probably used a similar method to that goblet, but for completely opposite effect, so it got a little of the shape. That's all.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Form but no spirit. In the end, it's just a—

steps.name: 'Sui-Xiang'
steps.text: (Wordless roar)

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Hey, look at that. You're pretty scared, aren't you.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Wh-What did you say?!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You know, I feel like you've been digging at me with that 'form but no spirit' stuff.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: It's been contained with this pavilion for the time being, but if it's disturbed any further... things will be tough.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What a pain. This sure isn't the kind of thing you throw a firecracker at.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Phew... haah.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Hm? Aren't you going to keep at it?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You really don't like lifting a finger!

steps.name: 'Sui-Xiang'
steps.text: (Wordless roar)

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Ah... so this is what scared you.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: O little Dusk.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Don't call me that!

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: I see you even shiver so. Are you fine?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: My li'l sister here hid in a scroll for a century without closing her eyes, all because she was so scared of this shadow of us here. Makes sense she's got stage fright now.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Don't you make such light of it...

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Even if it's just a reflection...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: To be precise, it's us three's reflections, and a quarter of it's Sui's.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: But It's us.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: What are we going to...

steps.name: 'Sui-Xiang'
steps.text: (Ridiculing laughter)

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Grrrr. Rummaging through my paintings. Are you mocking me?!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Uh, I'm gonna suggest to you right now to rein your imagination in. This thing already forged up my seventh weapon concept without me even thinking it...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Just take a deep breath, okay? Save us from getting slammed inside one of your paintings next—

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: —Paintings?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: You have noticed?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: The way is natural, and the foundations simple.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Sui was never of such fanciful tricks. In the end, this great Correspondence before Us, Sui-Xiang, is no more than the most unrealistic colors in our deepest selves.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Yea... Sui is but the Years of months drawn out long, and change has been vast. It is on the brink of madness.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: It's already mad.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Right now, at this moment, we're just one of Its dreams.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: When It wakes, we'll all be done for. We won't just be done for, Yan will suffer for it too.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Ling!

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: O little Nian, is that why you wish to resist It?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Then you surely have quite the sophisticated plan.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: That part I can't guarantee. I can only say this beats sitting around waiting for it.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Because I don't accept this.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I really don't.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: And you?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: She just dragged me here, that's all... and maybe I have the slightest bit of expectation.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Shut it.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: I asked after you just now, as to our collective exit, and your reply to me was that you 'don't know.'

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: This answer truly is not a fine one.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Look now. You are still you, with your own ideas, your own emotional ranges, your own adorations, your own fancied persons, your own fond sceneries...

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: To live in this land is quite fine, is it not?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Whatever It may do.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Don't we have any responsibility for It?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: —I am me. Why should I have much ado about It?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Myriad years the human realm was drunk, and it won't permit me one farcical dream?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: So your answer is?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: —'I mind not.'
Lift your head and drink.
Tail as a brush, ink as a shadow.
Let wind rise, brilliant in sharp anonymity.
Let rain fall, tassels soaked within.
And thus let the might of wine cleanse my heart.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: A board game? What game? I'm not too educated in the whole Art of the Piece.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Weiqi, the Go of Yan.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Now that's too complicated.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: What say you, then?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: How about that five-in-a-row one?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: A child's game.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Quite fine enough for me. You like playing this chess stuff, then?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I don't. The chesses are extremely boring.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Here I thought you were a board game maniac. You know, those types who only stop to eat and then keep on playing.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Both sides of a board follow the same rules, black and white doing death unto each other along crossing lines. What's the meaning in it?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Pieces, in the end, are just a method of playing games.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: So why fetch me?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: A fight of I against I is far too boring.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Wh-Where... Were we not just at the mountain's foot...

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Only they would be capable of this sort of thing.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Miss Ning, follow me closely, please.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: There seems to be... a bright light in the room ahead.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Really, now, starting the game without even explaining the rules.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: What about you all?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You'd really put me on the spot, asking me to play this stuff...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I only know general strategy.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: No rush, no rush.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I've waited... a great many years for this match.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Now, what exactly is beating a layman like me going to do for you?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: You should wait for your helper.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Lee? Why are you...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Liang Xun?! Er, and Miss Ning...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Greetings, Assistant Minister Ning.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: There is much I wish to ask of the Candleholders, but now seems not to be not the time.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Assistant Minister?!)

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Sit, sit.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: With this, it's more or less set.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: What do you intend on doing?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Having a game of weiqi with you all.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You don't like weiqi, but you'd yank all these people in just to play with you?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I suppose.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: That goblet of yours has done me some serious damage.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: If that lady hadn't finally exposed the truth... how on Terra would I have ended up?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Uncertain. Perhaps at some waking, you would find yourself to be the illusory dream instead. The bubble pops, and the one who opens his eyes, is me.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Now that's just plain terrifying.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Terrifying, indeed.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: You don't seem to feel any way about it.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Really, I said it was terrifying.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Heh... I'll leave it at that, then.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Both of you may think it was random chance, that Liang Xun should choose to involve you in this.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: But unfortunately, though it's true there is countless coincidence in this world, for this, you are the sole exception.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: There is a man by the name of Huai.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Your expression changes. It seems you only let out that mote of superfluous seriousness when your friends are mentioned.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Come. It's your turn.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I must warn you.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: One mindless move, and the whole game is lost.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hmm.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Lee.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Be calm.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: How did you escape, sir?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I thought for a long, long, long time, and realized one way. That's all.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: A ko fight. How will you respond to this calamity?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: This game...

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: In the game of weiqi, few can surpass you, sir, is that not so?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I've simply lived for a while. Any longer and it'd be boring.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Miss Ning, what say you to this one?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Don't overthink it.
Clack.
A white stone hits the board.
The outcome is clearly in sight.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I've been too recklessly about, these past few days.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: It's not your fault.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What does this match signify?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: It's only a game. Don't overthink it.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It's very hard not to.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Think about who wins and loses first. Your turn.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The state of things is evident to all at this point. You don't need to carry on mystifying them.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: So you want to concede. What about the others?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I imagine—the meaning of this game isn't on the board at all.
Clack.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: It's only right that our win or loss shouldn't be determined in this corner.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: The best tactic, with people who love to confuse things, is to play just as mad along with them.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'm not good at any kind of chess, but I am good... at reading people.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I'll answer the question you just posed, young Candleholder.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: There was an accident previously. I lost a... younger sister. You may be young, but as the responsibility lies with you, I'm sure you can understand what I'm saying.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: This isn't a topic you can discuss here.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: That is true. Please speak, sir, with caution.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: After that, my tiny little residence's piece basket was less one black stone.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: It was merely... broken, in that accident.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: And after that, I thought and thought. About what I should do, and what I even could do.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: The current Grand Tutor... The first time I saw him, he was but a deprived student, led by that teacher of prestige past the stagnant city, gazing towards that towering estate wall...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You have no freedom of movement. You shouldn't have seen the Grand Tutor before.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: He's an intriguing one. He said something that lodged deep within my heart, at a time when I'd gotten sick of these stone-cold counters.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You seem very boresome.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: To the point of stiffness.
Behind Lee, at this moment, are many people.
Friends, companions, high officials just met, and adversaries for the time being.
But Lee still can't see the person before him clearly. This person who appears as a false image of himself.
His features are indistinct.
So indistinct it puts shivers down the spine.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: One more move, and even if I somehow understood less about board games, I'd still be able to tell it was your win long ago.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: If you and I agreed to identical rules, what victory or loss could lie on the board?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well, that's some sophistry. You need to apologize to every grandmaster in all the realm.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: So be it. All in all, I've enjoyed my days carried at your side very much.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: This match is your win.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It seems we haven't quite finished playing.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I simply underestimated my... little sisters.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Our match has no real meaning. Call this my surrender.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I thought you'd be the type who never likes losing.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Hm? Ah... yes, I did indeed lose.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: And you, Cautus, name of Kroos.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Nian has an ulterior motive in choosing Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I wish you'd used a bit more positivity to describe Nian and our's relationship, ya know.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Mm... no matter. Understand it how you want to.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: You've no way to uninvolve yourselves anymore.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: *Sigh* Should little Dusk catch sight of your squalid garden, I predict she'll be of quite some temper.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: You've arrived.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Your tone, to my ears, does not welcome me.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Having so many about you to keep you company with game and talk? What could it be? Have you been too lonely?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: You saw through that mirage. If so, Nian and Dusk must not have been able to beat it.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: So you had guessed... Kroos, now allow me past. Let me be closer to my brother.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Uh... alright.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Come to mention it... when'd she ever learn my name?)

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: You played black. Who played white?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I cast myself as the piece, contested with the common folk, and was restless without victory.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Was Jie's disappearance the cause?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I've surrendered now. You all needn't stay longer. Only, Ling, there's a small present I've sent you that you haven't noticed yet. Once you witness it, come find me again.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Your regard for her...

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Has nothing to do with this.

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: I only fault the human realm for being so exceedingly dull.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Let's continue.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: What were you doing while we were stuck inside that strange place?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I wanted to choose a handy staff. I didn't find one.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Unfortunate.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Hey! Are you still about to go at it?! You had so long to rest, and you couldn't cool your tempers one bit?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Lummox! Master Shen! Come, now, give them a piece of your minds!

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: A change in the summits. This means what Mr. Liang briefed us about has come true.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Sui-Xiang has manifested. Higher priorities first.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I'd better go up the mountain too.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Then go ahead.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: *Sigh*... Will you really not listen to what I have to say?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Urgh! What happened up there—

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: —Watch your heads!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Ugh––!
Stone comes rolling down.
Zheng Qingyue brandishes his blade.
If only twenty years ago—no, ten years ago, he had the self-confidence to cleave apart these boulders as great as his head, not a speck of dust on him.
But he is old now.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Dad! Watch out!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: —Ye, my girl!
He is old, and his child has grown up.
No thoughts plague Zheng Qingyue. A rock strikes his daughter in the head as she moves to save him, and she falls off the cliffside. Yet without the slightest hesitation, he jumps down after her.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Innkeeper!!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Hey, now, hey! What are you doing—

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: —Why did he jump down along with her—

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Shen Lou!

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Cheh. I'll look below, and you get up there! Don't act without thinking, no matter what you see at the summit!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I'll go with you!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Ugh... how... Ye! Ye!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Ye!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Thank heaven, she's only unconscious...

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: If I wasn't deflecting at the critical moment, you two would have long fallen to your deaths.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: ...Shang Zhong.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Once again, Zheng Qingyue, once again!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Back then, you couldn't protect my son, protect Du Yaoye's father, protect that damned goblet!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You should know the blame you carry. It's still not time for you to bemoan yourself, and you can forget having any right to.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Your arm is hurt, and so is my leg. You and I are even.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Let us continue, before they get in the way again.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: One move will be enough.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: It's so tall. You really never sense it, walking ordinarily on the roads, how steep this peak truly is.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: People should not always walk on the given path.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Your move just now counts as having saved my life.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I saved the child.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Yes, you saved the child too. So how am I going to duel you for life or death now?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Why you!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Come on, then.
Deep in the forest, white snow still rests. The two face each other in silence.
The sound of a zither passes them by, its notes mournful.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Who is it?
Ling does not speak. She simply, quietly, sits cross-legged, seated upon an ice-cold boulder.
The wind blows aslant in the twilight, the sun about to set beneath.
This pair of enemies faces each other anew.
A zither's single pluck sounds, as if from the heavens. Even so, the girl is not holding one.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... Did we... make it out from that weird guy's grasp?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Looks like we're still not out of the woods yet.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Getting blackmailed by myself really isn't a happy experience...

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Lord Zuo.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Uncle Taihe.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I met the offender.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But if we truly take him at his word, then the three face their own self-shackles at this moment.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: You have misgivings.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I just don't understand why the Grand Tutor would trust that offender.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: If they fail, we'll be confronting their reflection here in Shangshu. Even if... it's only a small fraction.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: The Sui Regulator was planning to pressure Tianshi Bai into action with this.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: That's what my father hopes.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The sky!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The shadows are taking form... Is this... Sui's reflection?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: The Ministry of Rites has Bluethunder Count Bai Dingshan in Shangshu overseeing a team. This is only the Sui-Xiang shadow. It won't make waves.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What is it... looking at?
Zuo Le suddenly senses that Sui-Xiang is examining this land closely.
Now longing, now grieving, now merciful.
And once a breeze blows past, the massive shadow, in the blink of an eye, vanishes like smoke.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What! It disappeared?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: From a farcical dream, it awoke, and so disappeared.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: How did you...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Ling.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You could do things... like this, all along?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: We were there thinking of every way we could possibly save our own existential skins, and you could've just clapped your hands and broken that illusion up?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Our lives are but a fantasy, like a dewdrop or lightning, leaving not a trace in the end.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Scarcely known was it if you, I, or It, like the shadow's shadow and its shade, seem to be yet turn out not.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: So, may the one who comes to nothing and is shattered not be It?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You say that real lightly.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: It is but a lightest thing.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: And that is why I am your big sister, after all.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Sui Regulator demands Nian and Dusk give an explanation.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Additionally, the three of you cannot act in concert. You must leave Shangshu under the Sui Regulator's supervision.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What? Can't we just have a family reunion at Rhodes Island instead?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I still wanted to pull a couple more in.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Wait... are you serious?)

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: If Rhodes Island intends to attract even more scrutiny...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: If you believe what I say, then maybe you ought to come see for yourself.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: *cough* *cough*—

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: That's, uh... Well, considering this whole...
I will provide assurance.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Lin Qingyan.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Leizi!

steps.name: Leizi
steps.text: Long haven't we met, Kroos.

steps.name: Leizi
steps.text: Is that a new operator by your side?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I-I am the humble Nothing. Well met, Miss Leizi.

steps.name: Leizi
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I thought the Central Judicial Office was unwilling to interfere in the Sui Regulator's affairs.

steps.name: Leizi
steps.text: As a disciple of the Tianshi Bureaus, I simply exhorted my Master's good friend Master Taihe to allow all some leeway on this matter.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: No wonder Miss Ning always held her fire... You persuaded Tianshi Bai beforehand.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But at what moment can the Tianshis take charge of this matter?

steps.name: Leizi
steps.text: Naturally, they can't.

steps.name: Leizi
steps.text: But at this juncture, the Sui Regulator may not be allowed to throw down decisions either.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Leizi
steps.text: The Grand Tutor has arrived in Shangshu.

steps.name: Leizi
steps.text: Sui Regulator Candleholder Zuo Le, Assistant Minister of Rites Ning Ciqiu, Department of Discipline and Supervision Deputy Monitir Censor Taihe, Shangshu Magistrate Liang Xun, and I myself, must all return to the Liang estate before the Hour of Tzu.

steps.name: Leizi
steps.text: We will await the Grand Tutor's orders.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: As you command.

steps.name: Leizi
steps.text: Nian, Dusk, Ling.

steps.name: Leizi
steps.text: The three of you to the Liang estate too, please. The Grand Tutor wants to see you for himself.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Quite good.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Some thirty years and more passed since last I met him. How much he could have changed from then to now.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Alright, here we go again...

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Hmm.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: You are awake.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: A daydream.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: You and I know well this was their strategy.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: That game of weiqi...

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: All in all, it was by a fluke we didn't lose.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: It was but the combined power of all present, facing a lone person over a game of weiqi. No great brilliance to it in the end.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Brilliance...

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Doing battle with him, what do brilliance and disgrace matter?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: —Ye, my girl!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: ...*cough*... You're still fighting in this sorry state?!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Ye! You're hurt worse than we are! Don't be brave!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Zheng Qingyue!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Why did you... stow your blade at the last moment? If you didn't, would a hurt little girl be able to hold you back?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You want to run? I humiliate you and you have your peace of mind, is that it?!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I'm the same.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Ye, you've grown up.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You've grown up...
The zither ceases.
Ling's figure scatters into the air, like music about the beams. This is no beautiful dream. 'A small present,' he called it.
Now she has a question; a question she wants an answer to.
